correctness.rationale: Reconstructed complete 1-skeleton from common neighbors; normalized 1-cocycles at o=(1,1); verified all row, column, mixed triangle identities (equations (1)–(3)) and sufficiency of explicit cocycles over arbitrary abelian coefficient groups. When m,n>=4, all mixed parameters coincide and opposite corners impose 2t=0; coordinate-difference indicator realizes every 2-torsion t. With exactly 3 rows the remaining parameter is free and the explicit integer generator realizes it; at 3x3 two independent integer generators do. Natural H¹(-;A)=Hom(H1(-;Z),A) for all A and finite generation recover the exact integral groups, not just field ranks. Independent construction of all 2-faces and exact sparse elimination gave H1 dimensions over F2,F3,F5,F7 for (3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(3,7),(4,4),(4,5),(5,5). Independent integer Smith reductions found (3,3) free rank 2, (3,4) free rank 1 and (4,4) one invariant factor 2; independent explicit integer cocycle generators checked against every triangle for (3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(3,6),(3,8), and parity generators for larger boards. These are finite corroborations, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: H1 is a fundamental integral invariant of a natural all-parameter family of Lovasz open-neighborhood complexes, with a sharp geometrically meaningful transition from two free cycles to one free cycle to genuine Z/2 torsion. A related published all-parameter cofiber theorem explicitly left H1 open; the arbitrary-coefficient corner-cocycle classification provides reusable structure. Beyond the credited 4x4 instance and outside-width-two work, the answer is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary one-off computation.
